text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Boss! Your calm and precise 
judgment has been firmly etched into my 
memory!
choice_data_list: Still, I might've taken a bit too much.
Still, you might've taken a bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then how about handing them out to 
the children at the upcoming tour?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If we all have matching items, our time 
together is sure to be even more fun, sir!
choice_data_list: Great idea! Could you help hand them out?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Of course, sir! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If we have this plushie, they'll surely 
feel a sense of closeness.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
So as not to waste the Boss's hard work, I 
shall carry out my duties with all my 
heart, sir!
